loop.boundary: complete original selected block within authenticated parent bulk body

tail.boundary: complete original selected block within authenticated parent bulk body

fence.boundary: complete original selected block within authenticated parent bulk body

table.boundary: complete current native dword RVA table; every reachable indexed target must be an original instruction boundary

instructionReference.title: Intel 64 and IA-32 SDM Volume 2B, MOVNTDQ and SFENCE
instructionReference.boundary: Architectural register-to-memory store values and required alignment; SFENCE orders preceding stores before following stores, not loads or observed return-time visibility.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Current parent full-body authentication, complete original non-temporal loop and tail, exact SFENCE followed by vector cleanup and plain RET, and every indexed raw dword table target.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Checked parent aligned high-vector unsigned threshold edge enters the actual non-temporal loop. All checked stores carry the corresponding initial-source bytes; every reachable tail follows its final store with the original SFENCE/cleanup/return.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Supported vector/fence state, valid stable non-wrapping compatible ordinary writable memory, selected high non-temporal branch, forward-safe overlap and all parent source/stride/frame/bitset conditions. Store-value coverage holds after the checked stores become visible; SFENCE orders them before following stores.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous mode/runtime stride/provider representations retain their parent boundary.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Visibility at RET, subsequent load ordering, actual parent publication-store join, backward copying, general bulk/resize preservation, live stride/CPU choices, allocation/alias lifetime, renderer/parent joins and observed execution.
